findings.description: Sealed bz_16–bz_23 are not imported by engines. Interpretation/report still use legacy 07_sentence_library trees.
findings.recommendation: Add read-only adapters in an engine sprint. Do not mutate sealed packages.
findings.release_impact: Blocks engine_complete and commercial publication. Does not invalidate architecture freeze or knowledge seals.

findings.description: PVP VAL-GOLDEN remains not_applicable. QC-2 snapshots are knowledge-contract canonical, not engine replay.
findings.recommendation: Wire Golden Dataset when engines consume sealed V2 packages. Keep QC-2 snapshots immutable.
findings.release_impact: Runtime golden gate fails. Release Candidate may ship as knowledge/architecture RC only.

findings.description: AF-1 PACKAGE_INDEX lists 9 packages (bz_01–bz_09). QC-1 ecosystem inventory lists 23 released packages (bz_01–bz_23). Release manifests are frozen and were not updated.
findings.recommendation: Record bz_10–bz_23 in a later manifest SemVer after RM policy. Do not edit v1.0 indexes in QC-4.
findings.release_impact: v1.0 architecture certificate remains valid for AF-1 scope. Knowledge RC scope is wider than the frozen package index.

findings.description: bz_01–bz_04 lack assets/published_outputs.json. Downstream names implicit scores via DEPENDENCIES signals.
findings.recommendation: Backfill publish assets only via new SemVer. Do not mutate sealed 1.0.0/1.2.0.
findings.release_impact: Contract coverage warning (QC-3 contract 92). Required handoff contracts still published by later analytical stages.

findings.description: All 23 packages store 64-hex checksums. IK/PK KD-3 match. Wave 1 stored digests unverified by KD-3 two-pass: 15.
findings.recommendation: Keep checksums immutable. Do not regenerate Wave 1 digests.
findings.release_impact: Checksum gate passes as stored-digest present. Byte-verify limited to bz_16–bz_23.

findings.description: bz_01 package_version is 1.2.0; AF-1 peers are 1.0.0. Schema/knowledge/compatibility remain 2.0.0/1.0.0/1.0.0.
findings.recommendation: Record as known SemVer skew. Do not rebase bz_01 in QC-4.
findings.release_impact: Version matrix already records 1.2.0. No compatibility break.

findings.description: Luck foundation has empty analytical counts by design of the foundation pack.
findings.recommendation: Ship luck analytical rules as a new package. Do not convert foundation in place.
findings.release_impact: AX-4 pipeline remains released; luck analytical depth is a future package.

findings.description: Primary domain_id coverage is 13 taxonomy domains. Calendar and Shen Sha packages are absent.
findings.recommendation: Open new packages for missing domains.
findings.release_impact: Knowledge coverage 88 in QC-1. Does not block v1.x RC for sealed domains.

findings.description: bz_20–bz_23 store identifier graphs only; evidence catalogs empty by design.
findings.recommendation: Do not invent analytical evidence for presentation packs.

findings.description: QC-2 and QC-3 did not execute engines. Determinism is snapshot/orchestration reload.
findings.recommendation: Keep engine replay out of QC-4. Optional later runtime golden.
findings.release_impact: Certification is evidence-of-record, not runtime proof.

findings.description: RX-1 publisher, delivery, and print remain disabled. No filesystem persist.
findings.recommendation: Keep disabled until a publisher sprint owns the surface.
findings.release_impact: In-memory report artifacts only. Matches AF-1 freeze.

findings.description: Architecture freeze certificate BTE-ARCH-CERT-1.0.0 remains in force. QC-4 does not replace it.
findings.recommendation: Do not reuse the architecture identity for a later major line.
findings.release_impact: QC-4 RC is additive certification on top of AF-1, not a new architecture version.
